differential.name: Iron deficiency anemia
differential.rationale: Microcytic anemia (MCV 41 fL) with low hemoglobin in a middle‑aged adult, compatible with chronic blood loss from NSAID use or gingival disease.

differential.name: Beta thalassemia trait
differential.rationale: Marked microcytosis out of proportion to mild anemia, common in individuals of European descent and often incidentally discovered.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic disease
differential.rationale: Chronic inflammatory states (obesity, osteoarthritis, chronic pain) can produce a mild microcytic anemia.

differential.name: Occult gastrointestinal bleeding (e.g., colorectal carcinoma)
differential.rationale: Iron deficiency in a 58‑year‑old warrants evaluation for GI blood loss; age and possible NSAID use increase risk.

differential.name: Myelodysplastic syndrome
differential.rationale: Unexplained anemia with abnormal platelet indices (critical low MPV) in an older adult raises concern for a marrow disorder.
